accounts.title: Account management
accounts.subtitle: One place for login accounts, reseller authorizations and permissions.
accounts.resellerCreationError: Create resellers from the “Resellers” tab: their authorization requires an expiry date and a quota.
accounts.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account
accounts.confirmDelete: Delete the account for “{{name}}”? This action cannot be undone.
accounts.orphanCount: {{orphans}} account(s) have the RESELLER role without a reseller record, compared with {{resellers}} actual reseller(s).
accounts.orphanHint: These accounts have no reseller privileges: without a record, authentication treats them as clients. They are therefore not listed in the “Resellers” tab. This report is read-only; each account must be reviewed individually.
accounts.missingRoleCount: Conversely, {{count}} record(s) belong to an account with a different role.
accounts.resellerAccountHint: Login account — manage authorization in the “Resellers” tab
accounts.resellerCreationHint: Their authorization requires an expiry date and quota, assigned in the same operation as the account. Use the “Resellers” tab: it is the only flow that creates the account, role and record together.
accounts.passwordHint: A secure password will be generated and displayed only once after creation.
accounts.readOnly: Your role grants read-only access to this screen.

roleDescriptions.ADMIN: Administrator — Full management except system secrets

clients.title: Client management
clients.subtitle: Manage client accounts and activation validity separately from VPN plans.
clients.emptyHint: Add clients, then explicitly assign an SXB token and a VPN plan.
clients.created: Client created — no plan is assigned automatically
clients.suspended: Client device temporarily suspended — session and configurations preserved
clients.activated: Client device reactivated — duration and code unchanged
clients.renewed: Client device renewed — new activation code
clients.renewDevice: Renew device (+30 days and a new code)
clients.individualQuotaHint: Client account allowance, separate from each plan's quota and the reseller's capacity ceiling.
clients.lifecycleHint: Suspension temporarily blocks VPN access without removing the session or configurations. Reactivating changes neither duration nor code. Renewing the device adds 30 days and provides a new activation code; use “Data plans” to add data or days to a plan.
clients.confirmReset: Regenerate only the activation code for “{{name}}”? The old code will be replaced without extending validity, reactivating access or changing plans. The session and device binding are preserved.
clients.resetNoRenewal: The code was replaced without renewal: duration, device status and plans are unchanged.
clients.resetResponseInvalid: The server accepted the request but did not return a new code. Refresh the list before another action.
clients.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this VPN client? This action cannot be undone.
clients.resetAccess: Regenerate activation code without extending validity
clients.createFirst: Create your first VPN client account
clients.noAutomaticPlan: No plan is assigned on creation: choose the plan (configuration, data and duration) afterwards in “Data plans”.
clients.ownerHint: Determines who owns this client and therefore who can manage them.

devices.title: Devices and activation
devices.subtitle: Device validity and activation codes. Creating a device does not assign a plan.
devices.existingToken: This device already has an active token — here is the existing token.
devices.confirmDisable: Disable the “{{name}}” device? VPN access will be temporarily blocked. The account, session and configurations are preserved. Reactivation remains possible while device access has not expired.
devices.disabled: Device disabled — VPN blocked, account and configurations preserved
devices.confirmSuspend: Temporarily suspend the “{{name}}” device? VPN access will stop. The session, activation code and configurations are preserved without extending validity.
devices.suspended: Device temporarily suspended — session and configurations preserved
devices.confirmResume: Reactivate the “{{name}}” device? Neither duration nor code will change. This does not renew or top up any plan.
devices.resumed: Device reactivated — duration and code unchanged
devices.resumeUnavailable: Only a suspended or disabled device with valid access can be reactivated. Renew the device if its access has expired or been revoked.
devices.confirmRenew: Add {{days}} days to device validity, starting from its current expiry or today if it has expired? A new activation code will replace the old one. Plans, their duration and data will not change.
devices.invalidDuration: Choose a whole number of days from 1 to 3,650.
devices.renewalDays: Days to add to device access
devices.renewalPreservesAccess: Keep and share this new code securely. The device binding, mobile session and configurations are preserved: an already linked device does not need to activate again.
devices.renewalResponseInvalid: The server accepted renewal but did not return a valid new code and expiry. Close this dialog and refresh the list. Do not renew again: that could add more days.
devices.lifecycleHint: The status and expiry below belong to the device, not its plans. Suspension and disabling are temporary and preserve the session and configurations. Only “Renew device” extends this access and replaces the activation code.
devices.search: Search for a device, token, label...
devices.emptyHint: Click “Generate a token” to get started
devices.shareToken: Share this token with the user to activate their device. No plan is assigned: create a plan afterwards in “Data plans”.
devices.idHint: Copy the ID from the mobile app's activation screen.
devices.label: Name / Label
devices.exampleLabel: e.g. John's iPhone, Samsung Galaxy S24

subscriptions.title: Data plans
subscriptions.required: The client and VPN configuration are required
subscriptions.confirmSuspend: Temporarily suspend the “{{name}}” plan? Only its VPN profile will be blocked. The profile, mobile session and device activation are preserved.
subscriptions.confirmReactivate: Reactivate the “{{name}}” plan? Its duration and quota will not change; the device activation code stays the same.
subscriptions.suspended: Plan suspended — profile and device activation preserved
subscriptions.reactivated: Plan reactivated — duration, quota and activation code unchanged
subscriptions.confirmDelete: Permanently delete the “{{name}}” plan and remove only its profile from the mobile app? The device stays activated and its other plans are preserved. This deletion cannot be undone.
subscriptions.deleted: Plan deleted — only its mobile profile is removed; the device stays activated
subscriptions.confirmRevoke: Revoke the “{{name}}” plan? Only its VPN profile will be removed from the mobile app. Device activation, its session and other plans are preserved.
subscriptions.revoked: Plan revoked — only its mobile profile is removed; the device stays activated
subscriptions.revokePlan: Revoke plan and remove its profile
subscriptions.resumePlan: Reactivate this plan without extending it
subscriptions.resumeUnavailable: Only reactivate a suspended plan that is still valid and has data. Extend or top up an expired or exhausted plan first.
subscriptions.keepActivation: These actions affect only the plan and its VPN profile. They do not deactivate the device or generate a new activation code. The reseller ceiling is an administrative capacity limit, not the client's data balance.
subscriptions.dataAdded: Data added to the existing plan — duration and device activation unchanged
subscriptions.extended: Plan extended — data and device activation unchanged
subscriptions.invalidAdjustment: Enter data from 0.5 to 1,000,000 GB or a whole number of days from 1 to 3,650, depending on the action.
subscriptions.replaceHint: Changing the quota replaces the total allowance without adding data. Changing the duration resets expiry from today. Use “Add data” or “Extend plan” instead to preserve the balance and add days. Unchanged values are not rewritten.
subscriptions.resellerSubtitle: Manually assign a plan to one of your clients: choose the client, configuration, data allowance and duration.
subscriptions.adminSubtitle: Assign plans manually, client by client. Activation never assigns a plan automatically.
subscriptions.assignClient: Assign a plan to a client

bulk.deployHint: Creates a new plan for each selected client. Does not replace the device activation code.
bulk.setHint: Replaces the total allowance and resets expiry from today. This is neither a data top-up nor an extension; the device activation code stays the same.
bulk.addDataHint: Adds data to the existing plan without resetting usage or changing expiry. Does not lift a suspension or revocation; the device activation code stays the same.
bulk.extendHint: Adds days to the plan expiry, or to today if it has expired, without adding data. Does not lift a suspension or revocation; device access and its activation code stay the same.
bulk.noChange: No plans were changed. Review the result before retrying.
bulk.scopeApplyHint: Fill in only what you want to change: server, data, start, expiry. Fields left blank are not modified.
bulk.scopeDeployHint: Creates an extra plan for the client of each selected row. Server, data and expiry are required.
bulk.emptyMeansUnchanged: A field left blank is not rewritten: the plan keeps its current value.
bulk.noProfilesAdmin: No active VPN configuration. Create one under “Configurations” before you can assign it.
bulk.noProfilesReseller: No configuration is assigned to you. Ask your administrator to assign one.
bulk.invalidQuota: Invalid data amount: enter between 0.5 and 1,000,000 GB.
bulk.invalidDuration: Invalid duration: enter a whole number from 1 to 3650 days.
bulk.expiryBeforeStart: Expiry must be after the start.
bulk.quotaRequired: Enter the data amount to deploy.
bulk.durationRequired: Enter a duration or an expiry date.
bulk.nothingToApply: Fill in at least one field to apply.
bulk.tooMany: A batch cannot exceed {{max}} plans. Narrow the selection.
bulk.confirmApplyHint: The fields filled in above will be applied to {{count}} plan(s). Everything else is kept. Suspensions and revocations are not lifted.
bulk.confirmDeployHint: A new plan will be created for the client of each of the {{count}} selected row(s).

subscriptions.assignHint: Assigning a plan is an explicit decision: choose the client, the configuration to provision, the data allowance and the duration. Neither device activation nor client creation assigns a plan.
subscriptions.noClients: No clients available. Create a client first, then assign a plan.
subscriptions.noConfigurations: No configurations are assigned to you: request one from an administrator.

tokens.title: SXB tokens
tokens.confirmRevoke: Revoke this token? The associated device will lose VPN access.
tokens.noClients: No VPN clients. Create a client first.

vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.futureDeadline: Choose an activation deadline in the future
vouchers.clientCodeRequired: Choose the client and enter the code
vouchers.confirmRevoke: Revoke this unused voucher and release its data allowance?
vouchers.subtitle: Create and redeem prepaid data top-ups (vouchers) for VPN accounts.
vouchers.emptyHint: Create prepaid top-up cards that your clients can scratch or redeem.
vouchers.activateHint: Explicitly choose the recipient client belonging to the same reseller, then enter their code. For an already subscribed client, edit their plan in the Plans section.

resellers.title: Reseller network
resellers.name: Reseller name
resellers.emptyHint: Invite your first reseller partners to join the SXB VPN network.
resellers.futureExpiry: An access expiry date in the future is required.
resellers.invalidExpiry: The access expiry date is invalid.
resellers.created: Reseller created — account, role and authorization in one operation
resellers.futureRenewal: The new expiry date must be in the future.
resellers.quotaPrompt:
New quota limit in GB for this reseller.
• a number: exact limit (0 = no data allocated)
• “unlimited”: remove the limit
resellers.quotaInvalid: Please enter a non-negative number or “unlimited”
resellers.quotaError: Failed to update the quota limit
resellers.confirmDelete:
Remove authorization for “{{name}}”?

Only the reseller record is deleted: their login account and their clients' VPN access are preserved.
resellers.author: Author
resellers.historyScope: The history below is strictly limited to movements in your own quota.
resellers.subtitle: Authorization, expiry date and quota limit for each reseller. A login account alone does not make a reseller: only the authorization below grants reseller privileges.
resellers.existingAccount: The account already existed: its current credentials remain unchanged.
resellers.noLimit: No limit — explicitly chosen by the administrator
resellers.noConfigurationsHint: Without an assigned configuration, this reseller cannot create any plans.
resellers.createHint: The login account, role and commercial authorization are created together. This is the only flow: creating an account with the RESELLER role from the “Accounts” tab would not create an authorization.
resellers.expiryHint: Required and in the future: an authorization without an expiry date is perpetual.
resellers.passwordHint: A temporary password is generated and displayed only once after creation.
resellers.suspendHint: To cut off access immediately, use “Suspend”: it is reversible and explicit.

rbac.ownerLocked: The OWNER role bypasses permission checks: changing them here would have no effect.
rbac.preventLockout: Not allowed: a super administrator cannot remove their own permission-management access. No one would be able to restore it.
rbac.title: Permissions (RBAC)
rbac.subtitle: Choose each role's permissions. Sensitive permissions are highlighted: they grant control over accounts, quotas or infrastructure.
rbac.readOnlyHint: Only the owner and super administrator can change the permission matrix; the server rejects all other writes. Your role retains the full view.
rbac.grantHint: This permission enables actions with lasting effects. Grant it only if this role genuinely needs them.
rbac.removeHint: Removing this permission will immediately close the screens that depend on it for this role.

services.title: Available VPN services
services.subtitle: The services assigned to you by the administrator. Use them to create your clients' plans.
services.privacy: Technical settings (server, port, credentials) remain confidential and are provisioned directly, encrypted, on your client's device at activation.
services.empty: No services have been assigned to you yet.
services.emptyHint: Contact your administrator to have services assigned.

access.expiredHint: Your authorization expired on {{date}}. Your data remains viewable, but no changes are possible until an administrator renews it.
access.suspendedHint: Your authorization is suspended. Your data remains viewable; contact an administrator to restore it.
access.quotaReached: Quota limit reached — {{allocated}} committed out of {{quota}}
access.quotaHint: Creation and data increases are suspended. Suspending, revoking, deleting a plan or reducing its data allowance remain possible: these actions release quota.
access.expiring: Your authorization expires in {{count}} day(s) — on {{date}}. Ask an administrator to renew it before that date.
access.actionUnverified: Action unavailable: your authorization status could not be verified.
access.actionExpired: Action unavailable: an administrator must renew your authorization.
access.actionQuota: Action unavailable: quota limit reached. Release data to enable it again.
